title: Orchestration Shell Script + Docs

dependencies.reason: merge_agent_outputs.py must exist — orchestrate-agents.sh calls it as step 5 in the pipeline
prepare_agent_inputs.py must exist — orchestration pipeline starts with IR slicing

critical_notes: New files only: tools/bin/orchestrate-agents.sh, docs/ORCHESTRATION.md, docs/FAILURE-MODES.md. Do NOT modify existing Python or PHP files.
Architecture: file-based handoff (Open Decision 1, confirmed). Bash script reads dispatch config, launches Codex CLI per agent, polls for completion, calls merge script.
Open Decision 6 (parallel limit) default: parallel_limit=2 (conservative). Script should accept --parallel-limit N override.

Pipeline steps per multi-agent-plan.md:419-444: (1) Read dispatch config → (2) Launch agents (parallel up to limit) → (3) Poll for output files + valid JSON → (4) Call merge_agent_outputs.py → (5) touch <slug>-merge-ready sentinel.
Dispatch config shape: reports/<slug>-dispatch.json — slug, agents[], inputs{}, source_dir, timeout_seconds. See multi-agent-plan.md:406-417.
Each agent writes: reports/<slug>-agent-{id}.json. Polling: check file exists AND is valid JSON (python3 -c 'import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))' or jq).
Failure modes to document: agent timeout, quota rejection, invalid JSON output, missing output file. Script must handle each gracefully (log + continue or abort with clear message).
Do NOT implement Phase 2.9 Claude Code Verify step — separate concern (Session 21).
